motifs.name: towering_upper_left_cliffs
motifs.description: Isolate the large stacked cliff mass along the upper left edge, including the pale vertical rock faces, dark contour ridges, crevice shadows, and the small clumps of trees and bare autumn branches growing from ledges.
must_preserve: bold black cliff outlines and hooked contour strokes
soft gray ink wash gradients on rock faces
dry-brush striations following the vertical slopes
dark dotted moss texture along ridgelines and ledges
thin tree trunks, needle-like vertical foliage, and small red-brown leaf accents

motifs.name: misty_distant_peaks
motifs.description: Isolate the pale blue-gray distant mountain silhouettes floating in the open mist on the right side of the upper middle distance.
must_preserve: very light blue-gray wash
soft disappearing edges where peaks dissolve into mist
varied narrow peak shapes receding across the horizon
empty mist gaps between individual peaks

must_preserve: rounded pale rock shoulders with sweeping dry-brush texture
dark scalloped moss dots along ridge edges
dense vertical tree strokes in black and gray
fine reddish leaf accents on bare branches
white mist pockets separating cliff layers

must_preserve: thin black trunks and forked branch linework
small red-orange leaf dots on upper branches

rectangular window and wall divisions
porch posts and gate-like vertical supports

thin railing and post linework
